# Working Notes: Divisions E–L (Sanctions & Related Matters)

## DIVISION E — FEND Off Fentanyl (21 USC 2351 et seq.)

### Title I, Subtitle A — Sanctions

**§3101 (21 USC 2351) — Finding; Policy**
- Congress finds fentanyl/precursor/opioid trafficking is an "unusual and extraordinary threat" and national emergency.
- Policy: apply economic/financial sanctions to international fentanyl traffickers.

**§3102 (21 USC 2352) — National Emergency Authorities; Reporting**
- President may use IEEPA §§203, 205 (50 USC 1702, 1704).
- Report due 180 days after enactment, then annually; covers new regs/policies, sanctions imposed, info collection, OFAC licenses issuance/closure, pending enforcement, mitigation procedures.
- Unclassified form; classified annex allowed for items (C)–(F).

**§3103 (21 USC 2353) — Sanctions re: TCO Fentanyl Trafficking**
- President **shall** impose sanctions on foreign persons knowingly involved in significant fentanyl/precursor/opioid trafficking (incl. via TCOs).
- Sanction: block property/interests via IEEPA (in US, coming into US, or under US person control).
- Report 180 days after enactment, annually.

**§3104 (21 USC 2354) — Penalties; Waivers; Exceptions**
- Penalties per IEEPA §206(b),(c) (50 USC 1705).
- National security waiver by Presidential determination.
- Exceptions: intelligence activities (NSA 1947 Title V); UN Headquarters Agreement/international obligations; law enforcement; **mandatory** humanitarian exemption (agricultural commodities, food, medicine, medical devices, humanitarian assistance).

**§3105 (21 USC 2355) — Forfeited Property of TCOs**
- "Covered forfeited property" deposited into Treasury Forfeiture Fund (31 USC 9705) or DOJ Assets Forfeiture Fund (28 USC 524(c)).
- Report every 180 days on deposits.
- Covered property = forfeited under 18 USC ch. 46 or §1963, belonging to TCO-affiliated individual sanctioned under this subtitle, Fentanyl Sanctions Act (21 USC 2301 et seq.), or EO 14059.
- Does not affect blocked terrorist-party assets under TRIA 2002 §201(a).

### Subtitle B — Other Matters

**§3111 — Ten-Year Statute of Limitations**
- Amends IEEPA §206 (50 USC 1705) and Trading with the Enemy Act §16 (50 USC 4315): 10-year SOL for civil enforcement (from latest violation date; commencement includes pre-penalty notice/finding of violation) and 10-year for indictment.

**§3112 — OFAC Staffing Report**
- Classified report + briefing within 180 days; disaggregated by sanctions program and country/issue.

**§3113 — Report on Drug Transport Routes/Mislabeled Cargo**
- Treasury + agencies; classified report+briefing within 180 days; assess false cargo labeling, precursor shipment tracking.

**§3114 — Report on PRC Fentanyl Supply Chain Actions**
- Treasury + agencies; classified report+briefing within 180 days.

# Working Notes: Divisions L, M, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T

## DIVISION L — Mahsa Amini Human Rights and Security Act (22 USC 8501 note)

**Sec. 2 — Sanctions on Iran's Supreme Leader's Office/appointees/affiliates**
- Findings (a): re Supreme Leader authority over judiciary/security (MOIS, IRGC, Basij), Raisi's record, Mahsa Amini's death (Sept 16, 2022), protest crackdown, "Axis of Resistance."
- Sense of Congress (b): support Iranian people; hold regime accountable; demand end to abuses.
- Determination/report (c)(1): President must, **within 90 days of enactment and annually**, determine which persons in subsec (d) meet sanctions criteria; **impose** sanctions under programs (A) or (F); **pursue** under (B),(C),(D),(E); report to committees (unclassified + classified annex).
- Report contents: list of persons, applicable programs, whether sanctions imposed/will be imposed within **30 days**, and justification for any waivers.
- Sanctions listed (c)(2): (A) §105(c) CISADA (22 USC 8514(c)); (B) EO 13553; (C) EO 13224; (D) EO 13818; (E) EO 13876; (F) §7031(c) of State/Foreign Ops Approps Act 2021.
- Form (c)(3): unclassified, classified annex allowed; unclassified portion on public federal website.
- Persons described (d): Supreme Leader & office officials; President & cabinet; overseen entities complicit in abuses/terror; officials of controlled entities; presidentially-determined appointees/supporters/owned-controlled/board members.
- Congressional oversight (e): President must respond to committee chairman/ranking member requests re (d)(5) persons **within 60 days**.
- Committees: House Foreign Affairs, Financial Services; Senate Foreign Relations, Banking.

**Sec. 3 — Severability** (22 USC 8501 note).
